method: Five alternating AB/BA pairs per case by default, separate fresh sequential workers for each source/case, three complete export calls per worker, 1 ms heartbeat. First measured call separated from two warm calls; fixture creation, fsync writes and ZIP inspection are outside timed export. Storage source/image reads, checksums, image validation and private ZIP construction are inside timed export.
limitations: Real local ObjectStore and archive export only; excludes database snapshot lookup, account authorization, HTTP download/network and WebView. Fresh processes do not imply cold OS cache. Heartbeat reports scheduling gaps minus the 1 ms requested sleep; CPython GIL and timer scheduling can limit thread responsiveness. No real model calls or user data.

localization.method: CPU phases reproduce the current baseline preparation sequence; actual export separately records joined thread wait and verified storage wall time. Instrumentation and prior phase work warm caches. These are localization clues, not paired performance samples.
